name: Leon
source:
An engineer who lives with Tachibana next door to Cocoro. Leon met Cocoro in college after he was admitted early through an accelerated program, and she saved him from the isolation he felt as a young student. He's worshipped her as a goddess ever since.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3227510/Algorithm_Prescription/]Steam[/url]]
